words.trans: n. 注射器；针管  v. 用注射器注射/抽吸
examples: Tom got to work with a syringe, carefully dosing each dart.
The vet filled a syringe with the medicine.

words.trans: n.（二战日本）神风特攻队员；自杀式攻击  adj. 自杀式的，孤注一掷的
examples: Then the kamikaze-style ending, when they would dive the machines into the lake.
It was a kamikaze move that could cost him his career.

words.trans: 固定短语：无意间闯入、偶然撞见，不一定真的“绊倒”，侧重意外、不经意进入某个地方
examples: Anyone stumbling into the workshop would have seen the tension.
He stumbled into the room without knocking.

words.trans: adv. 极其；猛烈地；凶猛地，拼命地
examples: Faces ferociously concentrating.
She glared at him ferociously.

words.trans: v. 攥紧；咬紧；紧握  n. 紧握，攥紧
examples: Fingers clenched on controls.
He clenched his fists and said nothing.

words.trans: 指挥一次任务/行动（军事、行动场景）
examples: Tom directed the mission from a wheeled office chair.
The general directed the mission from a bunker.

words.trans: adv. 令人费解地；莫名其妙地；无法解释地
examples: He caught himself inexplicably smiling.
The door inexplicably swung open.

words.trans: v. 转弯，转向；弯曲。当主语是路线、小路、河流、飞行轨迹时，bend + 方向 = 轨迹转向、拐向那个方向（The river bends north. 河流向北拐）
examples: Before bending east towards Rigg Knott.
The path bends left just past the gate.

words.trans: n. 马蹄铁；马蹄形的东西
examples: A long climb to avoid the horseshoe of hills.
He nailed a horseshoe over the door for luck.

words.trans: v./n.（机器、引擎）发出高频尖细的嗡鸣、啸叫声；（人）哭诉，抱怨
examples: The whine of the drones faded.
The engine let out a high whine.

words.trans: 固定搭配：脱离…；远离…；已经越过，不在该区域里。强调不再处于某物范围之内，中间隔开一段距离，没有接触
examples: Maggie was soon clear of the village.
We are clear of the traffic now.

words.trans: 固定文学短语，主语常是河流、小路、溪流：蜿蜒迂回，曲曲折折地延伸
examples: Following the line of Perch Beck, winding its way down the valley.
The river winds its way through the forest.

words.trans: 短语：被……取代；让位给
examples: The farms and woods had given way to black rock.
Joy gave way to despair.

words.trans: n. 碎石坡；山麓岩屑堆（山地斜坡上大量松散的碎石、石块）
examples: Black rock and screes.
Loose scree made climbing dangerous.

words.trans: 短语：改变航向；变更行进路线（set a course 设定航向；on course 沿既定路线飞行）
examples: Shall I change course and keep the van in sight?
The pilot changed course to avoid the storm.

words.trans: n. 警戒线；封锁线  v. 封锁，设警戒线
examples: A line of patrol boats marked the security cordon.
Police cordoned off the area.
A cordon of police formed at the entrance.

words.trans: v. 推挤；争相挤过去；互相冲撞  n. 推搡，拥挤
examples: A hundred boats jostling for a view.
Commuters jostled to get onto the train.

words.trans: 固定短语：争相挤到前面，抢着要看（某个景象）
examples: At least a hundred boats jostling for a view.
Fans jostled for a view of the stage.

words.trans: n. 航海专用词义：船的尾浪、航迹
examples: Their churning wakes spreading outwards.
The ferry left a long wake behind it.

words.trans: adj. 静止的；停住不动的；不移动的
examples: An orange speedboat, stationary behind the froth.
The car stood stationary at the red light.

words.trans: n. 文具（-ery 结尾，记：e-equipment 文具装备；勿与 stationary 混淆）
examples: She bought paper and other stationery.
Keep the stamps in the stationery drawer.

words.trans: n. 泡沫，浪花
examples: An orange boat behind the white froth of the flotilla.
Waves broke into white froth on the rocks.

words.trans: n. 小型船队，一队船只
examples: Behind the barrier was a band of at least a hundred boats.
A flotilla of yachts left the harbour.

words.trans: n.（货车、店铺外面的）遮阳篷，雨篷
examples: It had its awning up.
The café put out a striped awning.

words.trans: n. 不在场证明；托词，借口
examples: An ice cream van is the perfect alibi.
He had no alibi for the night of the robbery.

words.trans: 极其轻微地（ever so = very）
examples: As he moved, ever so slightly, Tom saw a laptop.
She tilted her head ever so slightly.

words.trans: v. 重新浮出水面；（记忆、情绪）再次涌现、重新浮现
examples: The shock of the memory resurfacing was like icy water.
Old memories resurfaced when he returned home.

words.trans: v.（飞行器）紧急迫降于水面；丢弃，抛弃；甩下  n. 沟渠
examples: We need to get these multi-rotors ditched in the lake.
He ditched the plan at the last minute.

words.trans: n.（电子设备）实时数据流、画面输出、信号馈送
examples: Take some video from Skylark's feed.
The camera feed froze for a moment.

words.trans: 伪装成
examples: The weapons were disguised as seagulls.
The spy was disguised as a tourist.

words.trans: n. 秘密行动；隐身，隐蔽  adj. 隐身的（复合词里）
examples: The drones approached in stealth mode.
A stealth fighter flew overhead.

words.trans: 逃走、脱身、逃之夭夭
examples: How will they get away without being seen?
The thief got away in a waiting car.

words.trans: n. 步态；走路的姿势（专业词，指人行走时整体的步伐姿态）（limping gait 一瘸一拐的走路姿态）
examples: The man had a limping gait.
He had the confident gait of an athlete.

words.trans: n. 脚掌；脚底；（鞋子的）鞋底
examples: He pressed his bare sole to the cold floor.
The sole of my shoe is worn through.

words.trans: n. 决心，坚定的意志（名词）（He felt his resolve tighten. 他感到自己的决心愈发坚定）
examples: He felt his resolve tighten.
She wavered in her resolve to quit.
He failed in his resolve to stay calm.

words.trans: 乱糟糟的一堆……
examples: A clutter of boxes blocked the door.
A clutter of papers covered the desk.

words.trans: 慢慢挤着穿过……
examples: She edged her way through the crowd.
He edged his way to the front.

words.trans: v.（鸟类、飞行器）盘旋，兜大圈飞行；不是“被人操控轮子”那种意思
examples: The hawk wheeled high above the field.
The plane wheeled around before landing.

words.trans: v. 突然急转弯；猛地转向避让；急转偏离原来路线
examples: The car swerved to avoid a dog.
He swerved off the road at the last second.

words.trans: v. 尖声呼啸；哀号；哭嚎  n. 刺耳的呼啸声；凄厉的哀鸣
examples: The wail of a siren.
The wind wailed through the trees.

words.trans: 警笛尖啸（the wail of a siren）
examples: The wail of a siren cut through the air.
We heard the wail of a siren approaching.
The wail of a siren woke the whole street.

words.trans: v.（动词）猛踩油门；把发动机开到最大马力
examples: He gunned the engine and sped off.
She gunned the throttle to pass the truck.

words.trans: 螺旋盘旋向下俯冲（corkscrewing down）
examples: The hawk was corkscrewing down toward its prey.
The plane corkscrewed down through the clouds.

words.trans: n. 猎物；捕猎的目标（down on their prey 向着它们的猎物俯冲过去）
examples: Down on their prey.
The hawk dove for its prey.
The lion stalked its prey.

words.trans: 船的烟囱（老式大轮船常用 funnel，不用 chimney；chimney 一般指房屋、壁炉的烟囱）
examples: Black smoke poured from the funnel.
The old ship's funnel towered above the deck.

words.trans: adv.【航海】在船尾；向船尾；船后方
examples: Ram engines astern.
There was a wake trailing astern.

words.trans: v. 猛撞、撞击
examples: He tried to ram his boat into the steamer.
The truck rammed into the barrier.

words.trans: 航海口语：将引擎猛地切到倒车（全速倒挡）（ram engines astern）
examples: The captain ordered ram engines astern.
He slammed ram engines astern to stop the collision.

words.trans: 抢船头；从他的船头前方横向横穿过去（cut across his bow）
examples: A small boat cut across his bow.
Never cut across a large ship's bow.
A kayaker cut across our bow.

words.trans: 看在眼里，领会、看清眼前发生的一切（could hardly take it in 几乎难以看清/反应过来，场面太乱、信息太多，大脑一下子接收不过来）
examples: He could hardly take it in.
She stood there, trying to take it all in.

words.trans: n. 违抗；蔑视；拒不服从，公然对抗
examples: Jaw locked in defiance.
She shouted the answer in defiance.
He folded his arms in open defiance.

words.trans: 牙关紧咬，满脸桀骜对抗、拒不认输的神情（jaw locked in defiance）
examples: The boy stood with his jaw locked in defiance.
She met their stares, jaw locked in defiance.

words.trans: 拥挤扭作一团的一群人（a scrum of people）
examples: A scrum of people surrounded the celebrity.
A scrum of fans blocked the exit.

words.trans: 左舷船头（左船艏）（port bow）
examples: The birds hit the water off the port bow.
A light appeared dead ahead on the port bow.
The buoy lay just off the port bow.

words.trans: 固定搭配，描述突然爆发出来的情绪/动作：break into a smile 突然笑起来；break into laughter 轰然大笑；break into tears 突然大哭；break into a run 猛地跑起来
examples: She broke into a smile.
He broke into a run.
They broke into laughter.
